results.name: Exact capabilities preserve scope, active dates, explicit denies and actual actor requirements
Coverage reports partial subtrees without turning an ancestor grant into a child-deny bypass
Shared references use scoped read coverage while shared mutation and export remain exact
Missing subject scope and invalid navigation never widen to whole-organization permission
Role lenses derive from current grants and verified ownership, never from title text
Switching the lens preserves all live access and rejects unavailable responsibilities
Navigation and cached search follow actor capability and exact source location
A reporting-only person receives leadership workspaces without operational write surfaces
Named program ownership and responding remain legitimate and exact denies still win
New operational drafts start in a permitted location and record the actual preparer
Direct control commands bind the actual tester and assigned independent reviewer
Control moves and edits recheck original plus proposed scopes and revoked grants
RCSA draft and decision check the real first-line and assigned review identities
KRI submission rechecks authorization after confirmation and cannot select an impersonated reviewer
Privacy decisions preserve source independence and block name-only reviewer switching
A branch grant cannot publish a shared form or a whole-organization program
Legacy privacy cases without a named reviewer stay reviewable under exact independent authority
Action visibility and draft guards use the same real capability as their commits
Other people can inspect an action but only its actual owner may complete or reopen it
All role views render real registered actions, escaped source names and useful access explanations
